answer: Raven walk audit: each new key needs 3 vouchers who each lock 5% of their standing, so a fake costs 3 real honest edges plus 15% stake. Every epoch the chain launches 200 random walks from seed members; a farm linked by few edges traps walks in a tight spiral, so keys reached by under 2% of walks are frozen and their vouchers slashed. Lotus scoring lets trust bloom only outward from verified petals, and each member may vouch twice per epoch, so a farm cannot bulk-buy or share vouches: every fake needs its own cut edges.
